result.summary: The page is mostly clean. The main visual defect is the misaligned cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. There are also minor contrast and consistency issues.

issues.description: The cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel are not aligned. Green Bowl Poké has a taller image (starting near y≈631) than Smash Bros Burgers and Trattoria Piccola (starting near y≈658). Their titles and delivery-fee text therefore sit at different vertical positions (801 vs 829), and the time badges are offset too.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards the same image height and top alignment, using a fixed aspect ratio so titles and meta text line up on one baseline.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen', the '(500+)' rating count) and the inactive tab labels are light gray on white and have low contrast.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text and inactive tab colors to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons are inconsistent. On the ramen card the heart has no background, so it may be hard to see against the image. On the pizza card it has a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use the same favorite button style, such as a semi-transparent circular backdrop, on every card.

issues.description: The promo banner's decorative circles are cropped awkwardly at the right and bottom edges, and one of them has a hard-edged corner artifact at the bottom right.
issues.suggestion: Adjust or clip the decorative shapes cleanly so they look intentional.
